integrity: Formula follows a self-contained canonical fiber bijection; finite enumerations check small cases, not the unbounded theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only ordered pairs of commuting total idempotent self-maps on finite labeled sets. Exhaustive program comparisons stop at six points. A closely related 2002 centralizer article was not available in full, and priority is not independently certified.
title: Joint image-rank spectra of commuting idempotents in finite transformation monoids
